sourceWitness.excerpt: 三一二九頁一二行尚書令各五千按：盧云「令」下疑脫「史」字。

translationRepairDecisions.before: The surname was miscopied as chen ‘minister.’
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Here Liu Zhao quotes Wei Zhao's commentary on the Guoyu; the character chen ('minister') should read Wei (for Wei Zhao).
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: Idiomatic must not leave raw 臣/韋 graphs.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 按：此劉昭引韋昭注國語文，「臣」當作「韋」。

translationRepairDecisions.before: Witnesses disagree on whether the clause repeats ‘gate’ or uses ‘beyond.’
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: The Jijie cites Huang Shan: Qin Huitian, following an old edition, reads wai zhi (outside) for men wai (outside the gate).
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: Render graph contrast in English for idiomatic field.
